notes.title: We've updated the demo! 🎉
notes.content:
✨ Thank you for your feedback

Thanks to your amazing feedback through Steam Discussions and Discord, we realized there were a few important things missing from the demo — and we’ve been working hard to bring them in as quickly as possible. One of the most requested features was the ability to ​​automatically save your progress​​, and we’re happy to say: it’s finally here! 😊

We were genuinely touched to see how many of you wanted to spend more time in the game — it means the world to us.

But that’s not all! Here’s a full list of what’s new and improved: ​

📝 Changelog:

•   Implemented the ​​automatic save system​​ (thanks to everyone who pointed this out on the forum!)
•   Added a ​​sharpening effect​​ – the game should now look less blurry
•   Fixed ​​gobold spawn issues​​, including a bug that caused empty fights (also reported on the forum)
•   Improved and polished the ​​quest log
•   Increased the size of ​​consumable item counters​​ on the bottom left of the exploration screen
•   In combat, the lower number now shows the ​​maximum healable value​​ instead of max HP – this should make it easier to see who can still be healed (forum feedback!)
•   Fixed an issue where the ​​formation setup would reset​​ – it should now stay as you set it (thanks again, forum!)
•   Added a ​​camera reset​​ option – just press ​​Z
•   Visual improvements to trees – birchbark is now less bright, and we reduced flickering
•   Fixed various ​​typos
•   Save settings (volume, graphics, etc.) should now ​​persist between sessions​​ instead of resetting (forum feedback!)
•   Added a few ​​extra hints​​ to help you out
•   The ​​first-time demo popup​​ no longer says saving isn’t available
•   Plus many other ​​small tweaks, fixes, and optimizations 

📽️ And one more thing

We’ve prepared a short ​​video​​ where we talk about what makes our game special and how it stands out. We’d love for you to check it out!

notes.title: The Key to Survival in Sigilfarer​
notes.content:
🔨 Resource Management

In the vast and unpredictable world of ​Sigilfarer​, managing your resources wisely is essential for your party’s survival and success. Proper preparation can mean the difference between victory and defeat on your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/41d128ed7a691c934ca9efaf9b14d77785ec8d78.png

Essential Supplies​​
Resources in ​Sigilfarer​ play a crucial role in keeping your party alive. Stocking up in town before setting out is a smart strategy. Magic potions restore a character’s HP after battle, while food replenishes the health of your entire group, ensuring they’re ready for the challenges ahead.​​

Strategic Resources​​
Beyond healing items, other resources are just as vital. Shards power your protective sigil, shielding your party from the encroaching plague. Meanwhile, gathering materials to build a camp allows your team to rest and recover, providing a much-needed break during long and dangerous journeys.​​

Planning Ahead​​
While you can sometimes find resources through events, relying on luck is risky. Supplies may not always be available when you need them most. That’s why purchasing resources in town—when you have the means—is a wise investment in your survival.

notes.title: Sigils: Your Lifeline in Sigilfarer
notes.content:
💎 Sigils. What are they, and what do they do?

In the dangerous world of Sigilfarer, Sigils are your most important tool. They act as a shield between your caravan and the spreading plague. To survive in these risky lands, you need to understand and manage these magical crystals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/161f05386959b7379b03aee0ec340326654136bd.png

The protective Sigil, shown as a purple crystal, is your defence against the land's corruption. As you move across the hexagonal map, the Sigil's power weakens with each step. It's crucial to keep it charged to protect your group.

You can recharge your Sigil in a few ways. Cities offer a safe place to restore its power, and wild crystals you find on your journey can unexpectedly boost your defences. Also, carrying shards in your gear is smart for when your Sigil's energy is low.

If you don't keep your Sigil charged, your group will start taking damage. If this continues, it will lead to their defeat and eventually — a game over. So, managing your Sigil's energy is essential for survival!

notes.title: Mastering the Dice
notes.content:
🎲 Unleash Your Strategy in Sigilfarer's Combat

In Sigilfarer, rolling the dice is a big part of the fun and strategy in battles. When you dive into turn-based combat, the dice decide your moves, so planning and picking the right gear are super important.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/29c27149b2ce528440681c70a035acb817c09b4a.png

When you bump into enemies, you switch to turn-based combat. Here, each character rolls a d6 to see what they can do that round. This adds a bit of luck to the mix, as both you and the enemies roll to decide your actions. But watch out—once in a fight, you can't look up enemy skills, making each fight a bit unpredictable!

Each character rolls just one die, but your gear can really change the game. Some equipment can cover more sides of the die, leaving fewer blank spots and boosting your chances of rolling something good. So, keep upgrading your gear to get better in battles!

If you don't like your roll, you can try again, but you can't do this too often. So, use your rerolls wisely to turn the battle in your favor.

notes.title: How Does Inventory Affect Your Character's Abilities?

As we journey through the captivating world of Sigilfarer, it's essential to understand one of the most critical aspects of our adventure: the character inventory. 

The inventory isn't just a storage bag—it's an intricate system that shapes our abilities in battle, determining success or failure in every encounter.

In Sigilfarer, the items our characters wear directly influence their abilities during combat. Let's explore this further by taking a closer look at our trusted Warrior. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/7b4decd08e2414980a1d7e7490351e98eae2a1ec.jpg

Equipped with a sword and a shield, we can see these items showcased at the bottom of the screen. Each item isn’t just for decoration; these objects translate into our Warrior's arsenal of abilities visible on the left side of the screen. For example, the sword grants our Warrior an attack, dealing 3 damage. Meanwhile, the shield not only defends him, but also provides a valuable ability to protect both him and his allies.

It's important to remember that characters can only equip items meant for their specific class. For instance, our Druid cannot wield the Warrior's hefty sword and shield, just as our Warrior can't adorn the Druid's magical gear. This brings us to our dear Druid. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/45707c452486afc98346ea1cd87d14a63cf64270.png

Currently, the Druid's equipment enables him to heal an ally or the entire party. Yet, he holds a saber in his backpack. If we chose to equip it, our Druid could embrace the dark art of Vampirism, an ability dealing damage to foes while simultaneously replenishing his own vitality.

Let's take a moment to appreciate the Druid's spear—a weapon occupying two slots. In contrast, the saber requires just one hand. Imagine replacing those healing abilities; we trade 8 HP heal to an ally and a 3 HP group healing capability for a fearsome 12 damage strike that concurrently heals our Druid with 6 HP. That switch frees up a slot - this could be a good thing (place for another item) or bad a bad one (chance to roll a blank).

We must keep in mind that there are six slots available for these abilities because we roll a d6 to select our move. No one wants to roll a blank and be left stranded without an action! 

By mastering our inventory, we unleash our character's true potential. So, dear adventurers, explore the myriad of possibilities, plan your arsenal, and let your inventory be the source of your characters' strength! 💪

notes.title: Mysteries of Defilement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e847c7691828d1a88204e3c34f0a5ce5fb910810.png

As we travel across the mystical lands on our wagon, sandwiched between endless horizons and tales waiting to be told, we've come across many wonders. Today, we'd like to share with you some intriguing aspects of this world, focusing on a peculiar phenomenon known as Defilement.

In the heart of our exploration, we’ve come to understand that Defilement is a kind of mutation induced by the influence of wild magic on matter. Whenever beings are exposed to this magic for an extended period, they undergo extreme transformations or, sadly, face death. However, we’ve witnessed that some life forms find remarkable ways to adapt and thrive in such curious conditions.

Travelling through the land, we’ve learned about leylines, magical paths that crisscross the world, forming a natural network. Our world possesses a natural ability to dilute magic to levels that living beings can handle. However, when this balance is disturbed, it can have unexpected consequences. 

At certain places, particularly where several leylines meet, the potential of an area to contain magic can be insufficient, causing magic to spill over and transform the surroundings. Such transformations are what we call Defilement.

We've encountered various instances of Defilement affecting plants, animals, and even humans. In regions where wild magic is strong or sustained over time, plants and animals can merge into unique hybrids, showcasing features of both kingdoms. Even peaceful creatures may become frenzied and hostile, driven by an insanity that takes over their minds. As for predators, they evolve into terrible beasts, tormented by the pain brought on by their mutations.

Humans aren't exempt from these changes, though their consciousness and skill in resisting wild magic can partly shield them from transformations. Unfortunately, once the mutations reaches a certain point, they often transform into grotesque beings, posing significant threats to ordinary folks residing in enclaves.

Thus, our mission unfolds: to protect townsfolk and eliminate the defiled beings that menace our populace. It’s an uphill battle, but one that needs to be done.

Stay tuned as we navigate and protect this magical, yet perilous world.

notes.title: Protected by the Sigil
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e847c7691828d1a88204e3c34f0a5ce5fb910810.png

As we travel across the mystical lands on our wagon, sandwiched between endless horizons and tales waiting to be told, we've come across many wonders. But today, let's talk about something particularly fascinating from our journey: the protective Sigils of this world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/3706bc13311e61450d3358b625116457354ab257.png

Imagine a shield, not of steel or stone, but of an invisible aura that keeps the chaos of wild magic at bay. These Sigils are carefully crafted, either engraved in stones or carved into bits of wood, becoming a powerful tool when in the hands of a skilled magician.

You see, magicians possess the unique ability to draw raw magic out of the gems and channel it into Sigils. These protective Sigils then continuously release magic, creating a steady aura that acts as a barrier.

Their primary role is to ‘muffle’ the unruly waves of magic around them, establishing a zone of calm amidst the tempest. However, let’s be clear: a weak Sigil can be overwhelmed and so, crushed by the monumental force of wild magic.

Now, what's truly remarkable is the effect these Sigils have on living creatures! Tainted plants—those corrupted by wild magic—wither and turn to dust within the Sigil’s range. Animals, even those deeply affected, seem to shy away instinctively, repelled by the aura’s consistent waves.

The same goes for humans and beasts tangled up with wild magic. Though they may want to approach, the closer they get, the stronger the Sigil pushes them back. The nearer they get, the more they're repelled by the ordered, rhythmic pulses of magic emanating from the Sigil.

This is why the protective Sigils are quite a common sight in the big cities. They provide a safe haven amid the chaos. Of course, our wagon is also protected by such Sigil, as we traverse the untamed lands.

However, over time, the power of the Sigil begins to wane. Like a candle slowly burning out, its strength diminishes, which is why we need to plan our stops carefully. Recharging it in the cities has become a necessary routine for us. The journey demands that we be prepared, ensuring our Sigil is always ready to shield us from the wild magic that awaits beyond the city gates. This rhythm of travelling and recharging has become second nature to us, an essential part of our adventure.

Is there something you wish to know?

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e847c7691828d1a88204e3c34f0a5ce5fb910810.png

Warm greetings from the heart of Sigilfarer! ⭐ 

We’ve got some wonderful news to share from our latest adventure: 

Sigilfarer is now teaming up with Anshar Publishing! 🎉

But wait, Sigilfarer? Not Wanderer's Sigil?

Yes! Together, we came up with a simpler title that would still resonate with players, but keep the theme of a travel, as in our opinion, it captures the spirit of our game. How do you like it? 😀

You may know Anshar Publishing from games such as Zoria: Age of Shattering (a squad-based tactical RPG with fluid turn-based combat). Together, we’re setting sail to explore uncharted territories, add spectacular new elements to the game, reach a wider audience and make Sigilfarer even better  ✨

In the coming months, we'll be going to events, showing off our progress, and dropping surprises that hopefully will blow your mind 🤯 This is just the beginning of our grand adventure, and we want you right there with us! Spread the word, follow us on Social Media and join Anshar Publishing's Discord. Let’s make some unforgettable memories together! 💪

May good fortune shine upon you ⭐
